page.overview:
Who is Fine Line?

Fine Line is a female background unicorn pony with a light yellow coat, brown mane and tail, and blue eyes. She is unnamed in the show, but she is named in merchandise and other media.__TOC__

Fine Line shares her coat and eye colors with Sweetie Drops, Press Release, "Roma", "Paisley Pastel", "Cultivar", S05E21 Unnamed Earth Mare #1, and "Hazel Harvest".

Fine Line is named after Fran Fine from The Nanny, which her Enterplay card description references.

In Sweet and Elite, Fine Line appears several times during Becoming Popular (The Pony Everypony Should Know) and at the Canterlot Garden Party. She walks through Canterlot alongside Shooting Star in A Canterlot Wedding - Part 1, and she attends both wedding ceremonies as well as the reception in A Canterlot Wedding - Part 2.
